lines.text: Paul says a ratified covenant cannot be canceled, and the promises to Abraham and his seed meant One, who is Christ.
The law came 400 years after the covenant, and God freely granted Abraham the inheritance through a promise.
We were held in custody under the law, which became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus, and there is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female.
When the time had fully come, God sent an angel, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law.
